retire_or_promote_criteria.adapter_projection: Keep projection-only until a checked-in adapter implementation and tests exist; otherwise retire from publication blocker accounting as future context.
retire_or_promote_criteria.bounded_status: Bounded rows exit only by a mechanical clean/retired status change in matrix v22; capstone prose cannot promote them.
retire_or_promote_criteria.documentation_hygiene: Resolve by alias, source-artifact, or documentation reconciliation only; must not clean an underlying research blocker.
retire_or_promote_criteria.fr11_budget: Keep controller-only until soundness mistakes are zero and completeness budget is zero; promote only with non-tautological held-out evidence.
retire_or_promote_criteria.hardware_evidence: Keep blocked until external operator evidence provides host-visible GateMate/SSQA smoke or readback artifacts; conductor claims alone do not promote.
retire_or_promote_criteria.missing_artifact: Reduce by writing the missing terminal artifact or by retiring the row with a matrix-v22 citation to the absent source.
retire_or_promote_criteria.repair_gate: Retire repair headline wording if the verifier-gain precondition fails; promote only after the gated repair micro-panel writes clean evidence.
retire_or_promote_criteria.retired_status: Keep out of publication_blocker_count while preserving row provenance and the retired claim wording.
retire_or_promote_criteria.verifier_gain: Retire if verifier-gain evidence remains flagged after .288; promote only when abstention/calibration gates pass and matrix v22 records clean gain.
